Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every UI-only feature (travel, procurement AI parsing, hotel rebooking) has an API equivalent, and independent verification of full parity beyond vendor docs.

Ramp exposes a broad Developer API (Transactions API, Custom Records API, webhooks, OpenAPI schema) and CLI/MCP tooling that returns JSON, which gives an AI-native user programmatic access to pull most of their data in an open format. Missing for 10: an explicit full-account data export/closure feature, confirmation of open-format completeness (e.g., all historical records, attachments), and independent evidence of a smooth 'leave with your data' workflow.

Self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of financial-services SaaS; the evidence pack shows only API/CLI/MCP access to Ramp's hosted service, never an on-prem or self-hosted deployment option.
